arxiv-1904-00117.title: Estimation of cell lineage trees by maximum-likelihood phylogenetics
arxiv-1904-00117.creator: Jean Feng, William S DeWitt III, Aaron McKenna, Noah Simon, Amy Willis, Frederick A Matsen IV
arxiv-1904-00117.description: Abstract \presentadd []Seattle, Washington † † corresponding: jeanfeng@uw.edu (JF) † † corresponding: matsen@fredhutch.org (FAM) Abstract CRISPR technology has enabled large-scale cell lineage tracing for complex multicellular organisms by mutating synthetic genomic barcodes during organismal development. However, these sophisticated biological tools currently use ad-hoc and outmoded computational methods to reconstruct the cell lineage tree from the mutated barcodes.

arxiv-2207-02594.title: 3-dimensional flow analysis: A novel tool to study the collision geometry and the Equation-of-State
arxiv-2207-02594.creator: Tom Reichert 1,3 , Jan Steinheimer 4 , Marcus Bleicher 1,2,3
arxiv-2207-02594.description: Abstract We propose to extend the commonly known flow analysis in the transverse p x p_{x} - p y p_{y} plane to novel flow coefficients based on the angular distribution in the p x p_{x} - p z p_{z} and p y p_{y} - p z p_{z} planes.

arxiv-2211-00849.title: Fine-grained Visual-Text Prompt-Driven Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
arxiv-2211-00849.creator: Yanxin Long, Jianhua Han, Runhui Huang, Hang Xu, Yi Zhu, Chunjing Xu, Xiaodan Liang 1
arxiv-2211-00849.description: Abstract Inspired by the success of vision-language methods (VLMs) in zero-shot classification, recent works attempt to extend this line of work into object detection by leveraging the localization ability of pre-trained VLMs and generating pseudo labels for unseen classes in a self-training manner.

arxiv-2303-10369.title: Blind Multimodal Quality Assessment of Low-light Images
arxiv-2303-10369.creator: Miaohui Wang, Zhuowei Xu, Mai Xu, Weisi Lin
arxiv-2303-10369.description: Abstract Blind image quality assessment (BIQA) aims at automatically and accurately forecasting objective scores for visual signals, which has been widely used to monitor product and service quality in low-light applications, covering smartphone photography, video surveillance, autonomous driving, etc .

arxiv-2405-20288.title: A family of cyclic quartic monogenic polynomials
arxiv-2405-20288.creator: P. Voutier
arxiv-2405-20288.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by P. Voutier. We produce an explicit family of totally real cyclic quartic polynomials that are monogenic in many cases, and conjecturally generate distinct monogenic quartic fields infinitely often. Introduction Recall that a monic polynomial f(X)\in\mathbb{Z}[X] is called a monogenic polynomial if it is irreducible over \mathbb{Q} and \left\{1,\theta,\theta^{2},\ldots,\theta^{\deg(f)-1}\right\} is an integral basis for the ring of integers, \mathcal{O}_{K} , of K=\mathbb{Q}(\theta) , where \theta is a root of f(X) .

arxiv-2501-13867.title: Cotangent functors and Herzog’s last theorem
arxiv-2501-13867.creator: Antonino Ficarra
arxiv-2501-13867.description: Abstract . We present the theory of cotangent functors following the approach of Palamodov, and a conjecture of Herzog relating the vanishing of certain cotangent functors to the property of being a complete intersection. Preface The present article is an attempt to complete Jurgen Herzog’s unfinished last paper.

arxiv-2502-07649.title: Linting is People! Exploring the Potential of Human Computation as a Sociotechnical Linter of Data Visualizations Conference: Extended Abstracts of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 26-May 1, 2025; Yokohama, Japan Extended Abstracts of the CHI Conference on Human Factor
arxiv-2502-07649.creator: Anamaria Crisan, Andrew McNutt
arxiv-2502-07649.description: Abstract . Traditionally, linters are code analysis tools that help developers by flagging potential issues from syntax and logic errors to enforcing syntactical and stylistic conventions. Recently, linting has been taken as an interface metaphor, allowing it to be extended to more complex inputs, such as visualizations, which demand a broader perspective and alternative approach to evaluation.

pmc-10480386.title: MiR-3529-3p from PDGF-BB-induced cancer-associated fibroblast-derived exosomes promotes the malignancy of oral squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-10480386.creator: Dingyun You, Yanghao Wang, Jianguo Xu, Rongqiang Yang, Weizhou Wang, Xiaofang Wang, Xue Cao, Yiting Li, Lifu Yu, Weihong Wang, Yanan Shi, Changbin Zhang, Hefeng Yang, Yongwen He, Li Bian
pmc-10480386.description: AimsThis study aims to explore the role of exosomes from cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) induced by PDGF-BB in promoting the malignancy of oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) and provide new insight into the mechanism of OSCC progression and its treatment.Main methodsExosomes were extracted from human oral mucosa fibroblasts (hOMFs) and CAFs.

pmc-11414548.title: A rare adult presentation of chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis (CRMO) in 38-year female with exclusive spinal involvement
pmc-11414548.creator: Ahmad Ismail, Muhammad Shair Ismail, Muhammad Omer Khalid, Urooj Fatima, Muhammad Fawad Ashraf
pmc-11414548.description: Chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis (CRMO) is a rare, autoinflammatory bone disorder most often seen in children and adolescents characterized by recurrent episodes of sterile osteolytic osseous lesions. Diagnosing CRMO requires the exclusion of other conditions, which is often challenging due to its varied presentations and progression.

pmc-11610326.title: Genetic variants of ADAM9 as potential predictors for biochemical recurrence in prostate cancer patients after receiving a radical prostatectomy
pmc-11610326.creator: Yung-Wei Lin, Yu-Ching Wen, Chia- Yen Lin, Chi-Hao Hsiao, Kuo-Hao Ho, Hsiang-Ching Huang, Lun-Ching Chang, Shian-Shiang Wang, Shun-Fa Yang, Ming-Hsien Chien
pmc-11610326.description: A disintegrin and metalloproteinase domain-containing protein 9 (ADAM9) functions as a membranous bridge, forming cell-cell and cell-matrix connections that regulate tumor aggressiveness in various cancer types, including prostate cancer (PCa). Elevated ADAM9 levels in PCa were identified as a prognostic marker for biochemical recurrence (BCR) in patients who had undergone a radical prostatectomy (RP).

pmc-11626705.title: Causal association between glaucoma and risk of retinal vascular occlusion: a Mendelian randomization study
pmc-11626705.creator: Zixun Wang, Kaihua Xu, Xiaoling Zhang, Ruihua Wei, Zhiqing Li
pmc-11626705.description: ObjectiveRetinal vein occlusion (RVO) leads to visual impairment, and risk factors may include glaucoma. Although some studies suggest a relationship between glaucoma and RVO, it is unknown whether this association is causal. We performed Mendelian randomization (MR) analyses to evaluate the causal contribution to RVO of five genetically predicted glaucoma conditions.

pmc-12647431.title: Long-chain acyl-CoA synthetases: biological functions, diseases and therapeutic targets
pmc-12647431.creator: Xiaoliang Deng, Yanqun Luo, Ying Gao, Tao Wu
pmc-12647431.description: The long-chain acyl-CoA synthetase (ACSL) family comprises key enzymes that are integral to the fatty acid metabolic pathway and play crucial roles in governing fatty acid (FA) metabolism and lipid homeostasis. These enzymes are involved in multiple pathophysiological processes, including cellular metabolism, endoplasmic reticulum stress, lipid peroxidation, and ferroptosis (iron-dependent cell death).

pmc-12711893.title: Muscle synergy-driven ensemble learning framework for individualized stroke gait rehabilitation
pmc-12711893.creator: Jaehyuk Lee, Eunchan Kim
pmc-12711893.description: This study proposes a novel ensemble machine learning (ML) framework integrating neurophysiological principles from muscle synergy analysis to support clinical decisions in stroke gait rehabilitation. The framework leverages spatial and temporal features of muscle synergies using a hierarchical ensemble model to improve classification performance and interpretability.

pmc-13028808.title: A Taguchi-Based and Data-Driven Assessment of Surface Roughness and Wettability in FDM-Printed Polymers
pmc-13028808.creator: Mehmet Albaşkara, Eyyup Gerçekcioğlu
pmc-13028808.description: Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) enables rapid, flexible production of polymer-based parts; however, because of additive manufacturing’s nature, it creates distinct microscale surface structures. These micro-scale surface morphologies directly affect the functional properties of the parts, such as surface roughness and wettability.

pmc-13146353.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1168 HEALTH-RELATED QUALITY OF LIFE OUTCOMES IN PATIENTS WITH ACUTE ISCHAEMIC STROKE (AIS) TREATED WITH APTOLL 0.2 MG/KG IN THE APRIL PHASE 1B/2A STUDY
pmc-13146353.creator: Marc Ribo, Mac Arena Hernández, Caroline Petit, Daniela Piani Meier, Achille Dunne, Silvia Zaragoza Domingo, Danielle Harlow, Namita Tundia
pmc-13146353.description: Background and aimsApTOLL, a TLR4-antagonist single-stranded DNA aptamer, was assessed in patients with AIS treated with endovascular thrombectomy in the APRIL Phase 1b/2a randomised, double-blind trial (NCT04734548). Primary results, previously reported, show favourable safety and early clinical/imaging signals for the 0.2 mg/kg dosage. Here we report exploratory Day-90 health-related quality of life (HRQoL) outcomes.

pmc-13177821.title: Risk of death after type of intimate partner violence (IPV) involvement
pmc-13177821.creator: Ann Raymond, Toby Watt, Laurie Rachet-Jacquet, Hannah-Rose Douglas, Anna Head, Chris Kypridemos
pmc-13177821.description:

Men comprised 85% of accused-only, 21% of victim-only, and 50-51% in the other two groups.

pmc-13228143.title: Quantitative susceptibility mapping demonstrates ageing-related long-term structural brain changes in adult rats after mild ischaemic stroke
pmc-13228143.creator: Zuitian Tao, Charlotte M Ermine, David K Wright, Mohamed Salah Khlif, Vanessa H Brait, Lachlan H Thompson, Leigh A Johnston, Amy Brodtmann, Warda T Syeda
pmc-13228143.description: Quantitative susceptibility mapping is a novel, non-invasive MRI technique that measures tissue magnetic susceptibility, offering insights into brain iron, calcium and myelin distribution. Here, we used quantitative susceptibility mapping to assess whole-brain long-term susceptibility changes in adult rats following endothelin-1-induced mild focal stroke in the right motor cortex over 48 weeks.

pmc-13264132.title: Predictive threshold value of peak exercise systolic blood pressure for carotid atherosclerosis among the healthy middle-aged population in China
pmc-13264132.creator: Lili Zhao, Peng Wang, Ying Che
pmc-13264132.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the independent association between peak systolic blood pressure (PSBP) during cardiopulmonary exercise testing and carotid atherosclerosis, and to determine the optimal cut-off value.MethodsThis retrospective study included 459 individuals (aged 42–59 years, including 293 males and 166 females) who underwent health check-ups at Peking University Third Hospital from May to September 2021.

pmc-13355988.title: Comment on: “The status and determinants of demoralization in patients with colorectal cancer: a cross-sectional study in China”
pmc-13355988.creator: Kunyu Han, Jiahe Wang, Jiumao Lin
pmc-13355988.description: Zhou et al. investigated demoralization syndrome (DS) among Chinese patients with colorectal cancer and identified cancer metastasis, anxiety, and depression as factors independently associated with greater DS severity. Their study provides valuable evidence for psychological screening and supportive care in this population. In this comment, we highlight two analytical considerations that may further strengthen the interpretation of their findings.

pmc-13474759.title: The association between health literacy and out-of-pocket health expenditure: exploring heterogeneity by chronic disease in Zhejiang, China
pmc-13474759.creator: Xuehai Zhang, Xinyu Wen, Yunfang Zhou, Mingyu Huang, Dingming Yao, Xiujing Hu, Qiaohong Lv, Chun Chen, Yuya Song
pmc-13474759.description: BackgroundHealth literacy has been increasingly emphasized as a critical factor shaping healthcare behaviors and costs. However, empirical evidence on its association with out-of-pocket (OOP) health expenditure remains complex, and little is known about how this relationship varies by chronic disease status.

pmc-13567958.title: Bonding Performance, Mass Stability and Mechanical Properties of Self-Adhesive Resin Composites and Conventional Dental Composites: A Comparative Laboratory Evaluation
pmc-13567958.creator: Md Sofiqul Islam, Vivek Padmanabhan, Nansi Fadi Wahbeh, Lana Yassin Almaghribi, Nada Tawfig Hashim, Smriti Aryal A C, Upoma Guha, Muhammed Mustahsen Rahman
pmc-13567958.description: Self-adhesive resin composites (SARCs) are gaining popularity due to their simplified clinical steps. The objectives of the study were to evaluate the bonding performance, mass stability and mechanical properties of three SARC materials and to compare them with those of two conventional RC materials using a universal adhesive system (UAS).
